title: I built this with Claude in 4 weekends. Vector Storm
author: Pulsar-Arc-Studios
selftext:
(Cross Post)

Hello all! It has been ages since I have subjected myself to the wills of the redditors. It feels like coming home.

So I have built a roguelite with Claude(pronounced "clued"). It started with a simple prompt "build a hit steam game", mind you all of this is an experiment. It has since grown into this [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4724240/Vector\_Storm/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4724240/Vector_Storm/)



The journey to get to this has been slightly arduous, but luckily I have three decades of video game knowledge, from playing to working at EA as a tester and seeing the inside of the machine a bit. I have only coded myspace customization, and a simple html here and there. Claude did most of the heavy lifting here, I just guided it into what I envisioned.

I have a .txt file of my prompts that I can share if anyone has interest. It is not complete as I had the idea to write in notepad for prompts instead of claude code terminal. It's probably 1.5 weeks out of the sofar four week project.

The game started very simply, just a ship and some pixel enemies. Eventually I convinced Claude to add all manner of features, more enemies, more ships, more weapon types, more projectile types, power ups, upgrades, a shop, persistent upgrades, equipment items, leaderboards, achievements, all manner of settings, and I am working on getting a workshop mode to allow players to build and share their own waves and level progressions.



Each one of these features, and more that I have forgotten about, were individually implemented by Claude and tested by me. This is the future of gaming. One day we will just load up and interface and tell AI what we want to play and it will just build it in situ. This is what I did with today's AI and a few weekends.



I will provide keys to 5 commenters so that you can try the game out.

"*AI coding tools were used during*  
*development to assist with programming."* 

*"assisted"* implies u did most work, while u say it did most of it for you here..

replies.author: Pulsar-Arc-Studios
replies.body:
Well first off it's $5. And yes almost everything is AI created. I just directed it. Even the art is AI created. The description, the engine, everything but the overall design and feel of the game. Like I said here this is an experiment, and it just happens to be fun to play. The entire idea behind this was to see how fast I could put something "passable" to production and sale. A journey through implementation and the navigation of steamworks. 



Ideally I would take any proceeds over 1,000 and put that towards a profit shared game dev studio. But until then I will probably just keep pushing AI slop because that's what I can do.

Anyway here's a key TA430-VXGLF-JWMKP
